preconditions.description: The number of queries q is an integer between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 300000 for n in query_lengths)
preconditions.description: For each query, the array length n is an integer between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The sum of all n over all queries does not exceed 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= n for x in arr) for n, arr in zip(query_lengths, query_arrays))
preconditions.description: For each query, the array elements are integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(count_subarrays(arr) == int(output_lines[i]) for i, arr in enumerate(query_arrays))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output integer equals the count of stack exterminable subarrays in the corresponding input array.
